title: SyntheticUser
description: Schema for a single synthetic communication participant (Phase 2, Step 1).

phone_number.description: 4-digit internal extension, or a synthetic external phone number.

sip_identifier.description: sip:user@domain form; null for non-SIP-registered external contacts.

department_group.description: Department/group id; null for external users (see community_id instead).

frequent_contacts.description: List of other user_ids; empty when has_frequent_contacts is false.

org_role_id.description: The environment-specific Step 2 organizational_structure.roles id this user was actually generated from (e.g. 'agent_t1', 'dept_head'), before mapping to the canonical user_role vocabulary. Null for external users, who have no Step 2 role. Retained for traceability between this schema and Step 2's org structure.

community_id.description: department_group for internal users; organization_domain for external users.

internal_external_comm_preference.description: Probability weight this user's calls skew toward the opposite user_type (internal users calling out, external users calling in).

environment.description: Which Step 2 scenario environment this user belongs to.

is_active.description: Whether this user is drawn from the active fraction of the population (Step 2 active_user_percentage). Always true for external users. Internal users with is_active=false are excluded or heavily downweighted in caller/callee selection per the environment's inactive_user_behavior (zero_calls/minimal_calls).

call_weight.description: Selection weight consumed by Step 7's caller/callee selection: 1.0 for active users; for inactive internal users, 0.0 if inactive_user_behavior=zero_calls, else 0.1 (minimal_calls).
